name: 🫘 Black Bean & Sweet Potato Quesadillas
tagline: Smashed sweet potato and black beans with melty cheese, crisped golden in the pan.

items.name: Bush's black beans, drained and rinsed
Butter or oil for the pan

steps.text: Poke the sweet potatoes with a fork and microwave 8–10 minutes until soft, turning once.
Scoop out the insides into a bowl. Mash with cumin, chili powder, salt and a squeeze of lime.
Stir in the black beans, lightly smashing some.
Spread the filling on half of each tortilla, add cheese, fold over.
Cook in a buttered skillet over medium, 2–3 minutes a side, pressing down, until golden and melty.
Keep finished ones warm on a sheet pan in a 250°F oven. Cut in wedges; serve with sour cream, salsa and avocado.

kid_jobs.job: Scoop and mash the sweet potato
Make a quick guac: mash avocado with lime and salt
Cut wedges with a pizza cutter (cooled a bit)

chef_tip: Microwave the sweet potatoes instead of roasting: soft in 10 minutes, and the filling is creamy enough to glue everything together.
make_ahead: Make the filling up to 3 days ahead.
leftovers: Re-crisp in a dry skillet or air fryer; the filling also makes a great lunch bowl with rice.
swaps: Add shredded chicken for meat eaters
serve_with: Salsa, sour cream and a simple salad or street corn
heads_up: Sweet potatoes in the microwave first.

game_plan.what: Poke the sweet potatoes; microwave 8–10 min. Oven to 250°F.
Kids scoop and mash the filling with spices and lime.
Kids stir in beans, then fill and fold the tortillas.
Cook quesadillas in batches; finished ones in the warm oven.
Kids set out sour cream, salsa and avocado.
Cut in wedges and serve hot.
